implementation: Core checks fixed candidate identity, image type, positive integer dimensions and pixel boundaries; range and image_region are exclusive.
Shared React selection uses actual contained image bounds, pointer capture, outward pixel coverage and keyboard move/resize; no image cropping or copying.
Desktop and MCP share original task feedback, CAS and recovery. Old coordinates stay on the original submission.
Receipt loss after a successful host save is queried by the same operation, without a duplicate comment.
Narrow dialog reserves height for tools and coordinates; only the explicitly marked image is targeted by a region comment.
